Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class SellerListingService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.SellerListingService
public class SellerListingService extends Object
Task 2.4 My Listings: the seller's own listings and the two things the seller can do with them, edit (Manage Listings 3.1) and delete (3.2). The screen only shows the cards and the form; every rule below is checked here and covered by SellerListingServiceTest.
  • A1 - the form's required fields are checked before anything changes, with the same messages as Create Listings (ListingFormRules).
  • A2 - a Reserved, Sold, Lent, Given or Removed listing is locked: it cannot be edited or deleted (Listing.isLocked()).
  • A3 - saving an edit or deleting a listing declines its open offers and tells each buyer why (DealRules.declineOpenOffers(com.hkust.marketplace.models.Listing, com.hkust.marketplace.models.NotificationCategory, java.lang.String)).

Saving an edit normally sends the listing back to Pending Review (Listing.resubmit()) and tells the admin, exactly like a newly posted listing. The exception is the client's answer #5 of 16 Nov: an edit of a Live listing with no open offers keeps it Live, so the seller's small corrections do not wait for review again. A Live listing whose edit declines open offers is resubmitted, as are Rejected and Pending Review listings. Deleting keeps the record with status Removed (Listing.withdraw()), as Manage Listings 3.2.4 requires. The type of a listing never changes after it is posted, so each update method only accepts its own type.

    • updateSale

      public Listing updateSale(String listingId, String title, Category category, ItemCondition condition, String description, MeetupLocation meetupLocation, String typedPrice, List<Path> newPhotoFiles)
      Manage Listings 3.1: saves the seller's changes to a Sell listing and sends it back for review (3.1.6). Photos are optional; new ones replace the current photos, and passing none keeps them.

    • deleteListing

      public void deleteListing(String listingId)
      Manage Listings 3.2: deletes the seller's own listing. The record stays with status Removed (3.2.4), and the open offers on it are declined (A3).
      Throws:
      AccessDeniedException - if the logged-in user is not a seller
      ServiceException - if the listing is not the seller's or it is locked
